evidence: Sport, Power and Culture and its truncated duplicate account for 9/33 listed thesis-work citations and belong to the sports sociologist John Hargreaves. West Africa Partitioned, Decolonization in Africa and the Comintern article are John D. Hargreaves's; the Halifax thesis is John A. Hargreaves's.

Jorge Prata de Sousa wrote Escravidão ou morte (9), organized Escravidão: Ofícios e Liberdade (3), and wrote the two minor-slave-labour entries (1 each): 14/32. The photojournalism and Gazeta works are Jorge Pedro Sousa's; the Bissaya Barreto and Salazar works are Jorge Pais de Sousa's.

Hind Swaraj, The Story of My Experiments with Truth, Satyagraha in South Africa and the letters and nonviolence writings are Mahatma Gandhi's works. Mohandas Karamchand is his personal name; Mahatma is the honorific.

Only No tempo de dantes (13/29 listed citation counts) is Maria Paes de Barros's. A terra da mãe de Deus and the Octávio Brandão/Arthur Ramos studies are Luitgarde's; Tempos e Espaços de Mouros and A Comuna Muçulmana de Lisboa are Maria Filomena's. The cartographic-analysis article is by Letícia Renault and Maria Elizabeth Barros.

Carlos Estevam's Capitalismo de Estado, culture/CPC texts, Tecnocracia e Capitalismo, Estado e capitalismo, De Castello a Figueiredo and foreign-policy titles carry about 20/29 counts. A reforma universitária de 1968 (4) and Sociologia e ensino superior are Carlos Benedito's; the Uruguayan music article is Carlos Alberto's.

José Maria Neves's music books account for 19/36 listed counts: Música Contemporânea Brasileira (12), Música sacra mineira (3), Brasílio Itiberê (2), and the reordered music-title variant (2). The silk treatise is José Acúrsio's; História representada is José Neves Bittencourt's; Pesquisa Qualitativa is José Luis's; Comunismo e Nacionalismo is José Neves's. Mixed, near-even pool; no two-thirds LC majority is established.

Além da Conquista (6), 1755 (2), Nos confins Ocidentais (2), its Somanlu journal fragment (1), and História Geral do Amazonas (1) give Francisco Jorge about 12/28 counts. História de Santos (5) is Francisco Martins's; Callado no Lugar das Ideias (2) is Francisco Venceslau's; the Manila nutrition study is by Gutierrez and F. O. Santos.

Comércio e vida urbana, O império dos livros, Edição e Revolução and No Império das Letras are Marisa Midori Deaecto's. The remaining identifiable titles are her São Paulo/book-history research and collaborations with Lincoln Secco. Midore is a name variant in these records.

História do Teatro Brasileiro, Idéias teatrais, Dicionário do teatro brasileiro, O teatro na estante and O teatro realista no Brasil are João Roberto Faria's; the theatre cluster carries about 36/37 counts. A Restauração de Portugal Prodigiosa is João André de Araújo Faria's dissertation, with 1640 misparsed as its publication year.

Guerra e paz, Totalitarismo e revolução, Ronda noturna, In Medio Virtus and Os gênios da pelota are Ricardo Benzaquen's; his works carry about 35/37 counts. Habilitandos Brasileiros (1) is Ricardo Teles Araújo's, and Controle externo (1) belongs to the public-administration literature, attributed elsewhere to Ricardo de Melo Araújo with Marcelo Barros Gomes.
